title: Store Receiving Standard: Receipt Extension of the Free Hold on Ridgeline Special Order Services Items
content:
A slow store receipt inspection of a Ridgeline Special Order Services item extends the free hold of an order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The receipt extension depends on the calendar days from the shipped date to the store receipt inspection: more than twice the program's receipt inspection period adds 4 days to the free hold; more than the receipt inspection period and not more than twice it adds 2 days; otherwise it adds nothing.

## Records read

- **The shipped date** — the date the vendor shipped the item, on the order.
- **The store receipt inspection** — the date of the store receipt inspection recorded on the order; where more than one is recorded, the most recent.

## Bands for the deposit programs

Each of Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors, Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry and Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops has a receipt inspection period of 2 days.

| Calendar days from shipped date to store receipt inspection | Extension |
|---|---|
| more than 4 | 4 days |
| 3 or 4 | 2 days |
| 2 or fewer | none |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical shipped date 3 May)

| Store receipt inspection | Days | Extension |
|---|---|---|
| 5 May | 2 | none |
| 6 May | 3 | 2 days |
| 7 May | 4 | 2 days |
| 8 May | 5 | 4 days |
